measurement: Completed public catalog reload, including archive hash verification and parsing; no network.
limitations: One observation per variant; elapsed times are illustrative, not statistically established speedup.
ru_maxrss is the process high-water resident set, reported in bytes on macOS.
Cold discovery preparation only; not a live trading engine benchmark.
Market API pagination is not an atomic point-in-time snapshot.
projection_result_field: record_projection (top level): full, or [ticker, event_ticker, volume_24h_fp]

 raise RuntimeError('network must not be used during completed archive reload')
